title: Amour La Mer | KEY.co
description_expanded: - Seacrest Beach is one of the charming coastal communities that sits on 30A nestled between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Within the Seacrest community, there is a private beach and just 2 blocks away is the largest resort style family-friendly pool in Northern Florida with over 12,000 square feet of crystal-clear water. Discover your favorite cafe for breakfast in the neighborhood or enjoy the dining, boutique shopping and entertainment just a few blocks from Rosemary and Alys Beach. The stunning white beach is just a short distance away for morning walks or fishing. Golfers you are only minutes away from Camp Creek Golf Club. In the opposite direction, Camp Helen State Park provides a natural environment rich in outdoor fun including birding, hiking, kayaking and fishing on Lake Powell. This stunning three-story Florida Cottage combines classic coastal charm with modern luxury, making it the perfect retreat for larger groups. Its grand facade, adorned with porches on every level, offers a relaxing outdoor space for each bedroom, except the bunk room, ensuring a private sanctuary for every guest. Inside, the home boasts an open-concept design with airy 10-foot ceilings that flood the space with natural light, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The gourmet kitchen, thoughtfully equipped for entertaining, features premium appliances, a wet bar with a wine fridge, and an ice maker, making it a dream setting for hosting unforgettable gatherings.
rooms_guidance: Bedroom 4: Two Single Over Double Bunks
